//: Deny-all, deliberately. This used to be a detailed per-node ACL keyed on
auth.uid (Firebase Anonymous Auth), but the app no longer authenticates
to Firebase as a client at all -- see app/src/services/firebaseSession.ts.
Every read/write now goes through this project's own /api endpoints,
which use the Admin SDK (app/api/_lib/firebaseAdmin.ts) and always
bypass these rules regardless of what they say. The ESP32 meters
authenticate with a legacy database secret (FB_SECRET in firmware),
which also bypasses these rules unconditionally.
That means the old per-uid rules were never actually being evaluated
for real traffic (auth.uid is always null for the client SDK now, since
nothing signs in) -- they read like a real ACL but weren't doing
anything. This says so directly instead: nothing reaches the database
through these rules at all. If a client SDK path is ever reintroduced,
write real rules for it then -- don't resurrect this file's old shape
without re-deriving it against whatever auth model exists at that point.
